{{Short description|Dutch mathematician and physicist}}
{{Use dmy dates|date=March 2022}}
'''Henri Coenraad Brinkman''' ([[Amsterdam]], 30 March 1908 – [[Delft]], 11 February 1961)<ref>{{Cite web |title=Henri Coenraad Brinkman - Begraafplaats Westerveld - graf 1136938 |url=https://www.online-begraafplaatsen.nl/zerken.asp?p=1728553 |access-date=2022-03-26 |website=Online-Begraafplaatsen.nl|lang=nl}}</ref> was a Dutch mathematician and physicist. He was a professor at the [[University of Groningen]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Henri Coenraad Brinkman |url=https://hoogleraren.ub.rug.nl/hoogleraren/2229 |publisher=University of Groningen |language=Dutch}}</ref>

The dimensionless [[Brinkman number]] is named after him.<ref>{{cite book |last1=Alkemade |first1=Fons |title=A Century of Fluid Mechanics in The Netherlands |date=2019 |publisher=Springer |isbn=9783030035860 |page=104}}</ref>
